messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: 90% Confidence Interval of RMSEA.M2 statistic
parts:
Dear all.

I want to get 90% Confidence Interval of RMSEA.M2 Statistic when calculates M2 statistic.

How can I calculate that?

Cheers,
Seongho Bae.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: 90% Confidence Interval of RMSEA.M2 statistic
parts:
Hi Seongho,

I'm not really sure how to calculate this. It should have a similar approach to the standard RMSEA CIs, which I believe requires a bit of line searching, but I'm not completely certain. Either way, I don't know of a quick way off hand with the package that doesn't require using a non-parametric bootstrap. I'll look into this sometime though. Cheers.

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: 90% Confidence Interval of RMSEA.M2 statistic
parts:
Adding the CI's seemed easy enough, and now prints automatically when calling M2() in the latest dev. By default this prints the 90% interval, but this can be overwritten by passing something other than CI = 0.90; Cheers.

Phil

messages.subject: Re: 90% Confidence Interval of RMSEA.M2 statistic
parts:

Phil
